_comment: Sources of the editorial Siamsil Dictionary (docs/DICTIONARY.md), read by backend/scripts/import_dictionary_sources.py in this order. root is data_repo (the private siamsil-data checkout) or project (this repository). sha256 pins the exact file; a changed file stops its import until this entry is updated on purpose. rights names the data/rights.json entry. role: 'primary' is the dictionary's main source (owner decision 2026-10-30: the 50K Translation Master); 'reference' sources are kept for comparison, shown to reviewers beside the primary, and not reviewed or published on their own.
